description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you

Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
The Frontend Stack for Agents & Generative UI. React, Angular, Mobile, Slack, and more.  Makers of the AG-UI Protocol
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.

Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.
AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.
Agenta is a workspace where you and your team build agents and automations.

Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.
80+ production-ready AI agent examples in Python — build autonomous agents, multi-agent systems and agentic AI with uAgents, ASI:One, MCP, A2A, LangChain, CrewAI, Gemini, Claude and OpenAI.
A compounding agent OS for recursive agents. Also an open source alternative to Grok Bot and Meta's Muse.

Faster than your agent alone. And better. A workflow plugin that takes a bug, idea or ticket to a verified pull request: specs, cross-model review by risk, live QA, receipts in your repo. Claude Code · Codex · Cursor · Droid · Grok Build · OpenCode · Muse Code.
Conduit — native SwiftUI iOS client for Hermes Agent
